flags.name: file-path
flags.summary: Project-contained PNG, JPEG, JPG, or GIF image smaller than 2 MB.

commands.risk: Uploads a bounded temporary Clip image through the provider-declared file host and one Zoom-host bearer redirect.
commands.approval: Requires plan, no-network preview, and explicit single-use approval before execute.
commands.notes: The local source path is preview-bound and never sent to Zoom. The closed operation canonicalizes only the declared PNG/JPEG/GIF/JPG file into its provider-required base64 field at execution; callers cannot select a URL, redirect host, credential header, or arbitrary body.
examples: pm zoom clips files temporary upload --credential zoom-fixture --file-path clips/thumbnail.png --preview --json

commands.summary: Decrypt one Customer Managed Keys Hybrid archival data key.

flags.name: key-id
flags.summary: Provider-required Customer Managed Keys Hybrid key identifier.

commands.risk: Returns sensitive key material only through a redacted output policy.
commands.approval: Requires plan, no-network preview, explicit single-use approval, typed confirmation, then execute.
commands.notes: Requires an operator-provisioned Customer Managed Keys Hybrid credential with key_connector_base_url ending in /api/v2 and an environment- or stdin-supplied key_connector_jwt. The operation declares its own customer-hosted origin and bearer; it never reuses the ordinary Zoom OAuth bearer.
